acceptance: A Build floor finding that names a file under go/acs/cycle<N>/ starts a TDD correction with the finding, not a Builder correction.
A finding in a Builder-owned file still goes to the Builder.
A test drives both routes through the real correction loop.
fix: Route a Build floor finding whose file the TDD phase owns to a TDD correction, with the finding as its input. Keep the Builder route for files the Builder owns.
summary: When the Build floor rejects a finding in a TDD-owned predicate file under go/acs/cycle<N>/, the correction loop sends the failure to the Builder, which cannot edit that file. No route goes back to TDD, so the cycle fails with a correct implementation.
title: A Build floor finding in a file that TDD owns goes back to TDD, not to the Builder
